_comment: Fixed coin lists for cross-sectional hypotheses (ADR-0017). A universe is chosen by a rule that could be applied at its start date, never by which coins did well later. The list is copied into the registered hypothesis statement, so editing it here cannot change a registered hypothesis.

USDTM-2020.rule: Binance USD-M USDT perpetuals listed by 2020-01-01 (per the account owner's no-meme rule, no meme coins); a coin joins the ranking only once it has enough history, and its bars are used as they exist in the archive, including coins that later lost most of their value.

USDTM-2023.rule: For ranges from 2023-05 on: the USDTM-2020 coins minus BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT and XRPUSDT (their USDT-M TEST windows fall inside 2023-2026), plus established layer-1/DeFi USDT-M perpetuals listed on Binance during 2020 (SOLUSDT left out: TEST-14 falls inside the range). No meme coins. Coins that were later delisted or collapsed stay in the list; each coin joins only once it has enough history.
